predict.question: Your toy job pays a 50-point bonus after a successful attempt and zero otherwise. Success is stipulated at 20%. How many points do you expect per attempt?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Drive questions whether contingent rewards are suitable for every kind of task.
modelBoundary: Unconditional rewards average {A}; success-only bonuses {B}. The larger headline payment applies to fewer outcomes.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Motivation, enjoyment and performance responses to rewards are not modeled.
